title: Global joint MAP for a TN-facing fast-response and delayed-storage hydrology
hypothesis: Gauge observations can update the five global physical hydrology parameters, and daily hydrograph separation can add independent soft information about the delayed-flow partition, while the five Gauge coefficients remain observation nuisances rather than terminal flow multipliers.

candidates.H1: monthly total flow plus profiled station Gauge observation nuisance
candidates.H2: H1 plus development-only delayed-flow proxy likelihood

training_period: 2006-2018 total flow; 2010-2018 usable daily separation proxy
candidate_selection: minimum preregistered penalized development objective across deterministic starts
forbidden: terminal Gauge multiplication of Reach flow
interpretation_boundary: Hydrograph separation is a delayed-response proxy, not observed groundwater. Gauge coefficients are observation nuisances. Promotion evidence must be computed on the latent support/Reach hydrology as well as Gauge predictions.
